analysis:
The Prime Minister's Independence Day address said about 11 crore children were being provided afternoon meals every day under the mid-day meal scheme.

The Ministry of Education's mid-day meal page reports 10.45 crore children covered in 11.58 lakh schools in 2013-14, against enrolment of 13.87 crore in MDM schools. The 2012-13 coverage was 10.68 crore.

The statement is close to the enrolment/coverage scale but overstates average daily coverage by about 5 per cent; the official figure for 2013-14 was 10.45 crore.
notes: The PM's speech page on archivepmo.nic.in could not be fetched directly during this research; the sentence was confirmed through India Today's direct quotation and the Reuters speech text listed in search results. The Ministry page gives coverage, not enrolment; the 13.87 crore enrolment figure is from Factly's analysis of the scheme.
